## Proposed Q10 replacement

The earlier Q10 tests specialist consultation in hormone-sensitive cancer, overlapping Gynecology Q32. This new item tests ability to use a specific preparation, practical adherence, patient preference and safe medication instructions. It does not test cancer-related risk assessment. Candidate Q8 tests mechanism, Q9 tests local versus systemic route, Q30 tests adverse-effect benefit review, and Gynecology Q31 tests adding local treatment despite systemic HRT. These tasks are distinct from usability of an already selected treatment. Full related bank and candidate-branch semantic review remains pending.

### Q10. A postmenopausal woman with recurrent cystitis has agreed with her clinician to use vaginal estrogen. Hand arthritis makes it difficult for her to manage the prescribed cream applicator. What should the nurse do before she abandons preventive treatment?

**Difficulty:** 🟡 Medium · **Priority:** 🟠 HIGH YIELD · **Exam focus:** NORCET / Staff Nurse · **Topic:** Formulation usability and adherence

- **A.** Advise her to continue the same applicator regardless of the practical difficulty
- **B.** Recommend increasing the amount used on days when she can manage the applicator
- **C.** Discuss her ability and preference for local preparations with the prescriber and arrange instruction for the agreed option
- **D.** Select a different preparation at the same numerical dose without reviewing its instructions

<details><summary>✅ Correct answer and detailed explanation</summary>

**Correct answer: C. Discuss her ability and preference for local preparations with the prescriber and arrange instruction for the agreed option**

**A. Kyun galat hai:** Jab haath ke joints mein dard ya stiffness hoti hai, toh cream applicator pakadna aur use karna mushkil ho sakta hai. Agar nurse is problem ko ignore karti hai, toh patient treatment baar-baar miss kar sakti hai. Practical difficulty ko samajhna aur suitable solution discuss karna zaroori hai.

**B. Kyun galat hai:** Alag dinon par apni marzi se dose badhana prescribed schedule ka safe substitute nahi hai. Isse medicine ka exposure aur local adverse effects badal sakte hain. Missed doses ke liye product-specific instructions aur prescriber ki advice follow karni chahiye.

**C. Kyun sahi hai:** Local vaginal estrogen alag preparations mein available ho sakta hai, jaise cream, vaginal tablet ya ring. Patient ke haath ki movement, uski preference aur product use karne ki ability ke hisaab se prescriber ke saath suitable option discuss karna chahiye. Jab option decide ho jaaye, toh nurse uske specific instructions samjhaye aur check kare ki patient unhe samajh paayi hai. Isse treatment ko sahi tarah continue karne mein madad mil sakti hai.

**D. Kyun galat hai:** Different preparations ki strength, dose aur use karne ka schedule ek jaisa hona zaroori nahi hai. Isliye numerical dose ko seedha transfer karna safe assumption nahi hai. Naye product ki prescription aur instructions verify karni chahiye.

**Exam clue:** Jab patient kisi medicine ko use karna chahti hai lekin device manage nahi kar paati, toh practical barrier aur suitable formulation ko assess karo. Dose ya preparation khud se change mat karo.

**Clinical reference:** [NICE NG112 recommendations](https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng112/chapter/recommendations) and [NICE NG112 evidence summary](https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng112/chapter/summary-of-the-evidence). Indexed recommendation and evidence excerpts support considering patient preferences for local formulations. Direct HTML access returned 403.

**YouTube MCQ practice:** Verification pending for this item.

</details>
